pages.text: Gear to full diamond at least (Terrasteel or Enderium recommended) before you face Tier 3, the most varied boss roster in the pack: Meet Your Fight superbosses, Cataclysm ultra-bosses, the Cardinal Sins ladder and the Wither.$(br2)The ladder ends in $(bold)Lucifer$(), the Tier 3 combat capstone, last on its boss rush. Clearing all of it opens Tier 4.

$(bold)The Cardinal Sins$()$(br)The seven sins and Drakara have their arenas in $(bold)the Abyss$(); Lucifer's is in $(bold)the Nether$(). The Boss Compass finds each one.$(br2)Every shrine takes the previous sin's Soul Orb and works once, in this order: Sloth, Gluttony, Lust, Greed, Envy, Wrath, Pride, then Lucifer's Atrocity Shrine. Drakara needs no shrine: it waits in its arena, underground.

$(bold)Soul Orbs$()$(br)Sloth's Malevolichite Shrine takes a $(bold)Soulweaver Orb$(): 8 Malevolichite around an Eye of Ender. Malevolichite Ore sits in the floating pillars of the Overworld's Forgotten Forest.$(br2)Every other orb takes an Eye of Ender and the Essence the previous sin drops, at a smithing table with no template.

$(bold)Terramity's Chthonic Cathedral$() (the Nether)$(br)Occult Fabric on its Offering Pedestal calls $(bold)Enchanter Merlin$() and $(bold)Sorceress Circe$() together; when Circe falls, $(bold)Archmage Gundalf$() appears. Merlin and Circe count toward the Tier 3 boss rush.$(br2)Occult Fabric comes from Gatmancers and conjurlings, and sometimes from the Chthonic Dungeon's chests.

$(bold)Meet Your Fight$()$(br)Dame Fortuna and Rosalyne are {{boss meetyourfight:rosalyne tier}} bosses. Swampjaw and the Bellringer, from the same mod, are {{boss meetyourfight:bellringer tier}} minibosses: the Bellringer drops $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Storm's Edge$(/l).

$(bold)Wither$()$(br)Drops: 2 Nether Stars, Wither Bones, 2 Runic Tablets, 3 Rift Shards, a Void Fragment, often an Advanced Reforging Token, $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Soulkeeper$(/l) (15%). Your first Wither also drops the Dormant Relic. With two or more players near, it drops a loot bag of those spoils for each player instead.

$(bold)Cataclysm Bosses$()$(br){{bosses mod=cataclysm tier=3 kind=boss Names}}: {{bosses mod=cataclysm tier=3 kind=boss word}} bosses in massive Cataclysm structures and the hardest T3 content. Most drop a unique weapon and a boss material.$(br2)$(bold)Stalwart Dungeons$(): the Shelterer, the Nether Keeper and the Awful Ghast guard its dungeons.
